title: Post-Incident Report: Pod Failure
executive_summary: A Pod failure occurred in the 'dedupe-demo' namespace of the 'docker-desktop' cluster due to an ImagePullBackOff error. The incident was caused by a change in the Deployment configuration, which resulted in a 'Back-off pulling image' error.
incident_overview: The incident started at 2026-07-09T19:35:18Z and lasted until 2026-07-09T21:10:19Z. The affected entity was the Pod 'dedupe-proof-565cb79bd-sj2pn' in the 'dedupe-demo' namespace.
contributing_factors: The Deployment configuration change was detected 1.0 minutes after the first symptom.
business_impact: The incident had a critical business impact due to the failure of the 'dedupe-proof' workload, which is part of the 'Checkout' business capability.
technical_impact: The incident resulted in an ImagePullBackOff error, causing the Pod to fail.

investigation_findings.summary: The incident was caused by a change in the Deployment configuration.
investigation_findings.significance: The change resulted in a 'Back-off pulling image' error.

remediation_summary: The latest deterministic recommendation is to 'Review and revert KubernetesDeployment/dedupe-proof'.
lessons_learned: The importance of reviewing and testing Deployment configuration changes before applying them.
evidence_gaps: No evidence found for the verification checks.

action_items.title: Review the field-level diff
action_items.description: Inspect the stored before and after values for the candidate change.
action_items.success_criteria: The expected configuration is visible in a fresh snapshot.
action_items.notes: Corrective action accepted by Platform Engineering.

review_notes: Evidence and corrective actions were reviewed and approved.
